svg.title: moraine against the better of Lance and Delta Lake
svg.desc: Bar chart, logarithmic axis centred on 1×: how many times faster moraine is than the better of Lance and Delta Lake, 22 measures. moraine is ahead on 20 and behind on 2: Write records, half rewritten (local disk), 1.09× slower than Delta Lake; 2 writers, commit p99 (S3-compatible server), 2.2× slower than Delta Lake.
